description: CRONet deterministic dummy-weight HLS vectors for IEEE FP16

precision_sets.fp16: raw IEEE binary16 .bin; load as HLS half
precision_sets.fp16_words: raw uint16 words containing IEEE binary16 payloads
precision_sets.fp16_io_f32: float32 goldens after FP16-rounded inputs and weights, FP32 arithmetic
precision_sets.fp16_torch: raw IEEE binary16 goldens from PyTorch half forward pass
precision_sets.fp16_torch_f32: fp16_torch goldens converted to float32 for debugging

conv3d_layout_note: trunk_input [B,nely+1,nelx+1,2] is unsqueezed to [B,1,D=nely+1,H=nelx+1,W=2] for PyTorch Conv3D
